name: Bloomscroll
tagline: Turns course material into a vertical feed of short teaching and quiz reels, so scrolling becomes studying.

awards: Best AI project that uses the Gumloop API

problem: Students want to doomscroll but need to study.
solution: Upload course content to generate theory reels and test reels in a scrolling feed, with progress tracking that responds to right and wrong answers, built with an AI workflow platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: scroll through reels for a course and watch the progress bar move as you answer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Third Place” and “Best AI project that uses the Gumloop API” among 127 submissions.
Embraces the habit instead of fighting it.

lessons: Use the behaviour you are worried about as the delivery channel.
